comparison_method: Qualitative capability matrix grounded in local probes and collector semantics; no formal numerical scoring was executed.

status_legend.strong: Native or directly observable with the candidate after bounded configuration.
status_legend.partial: Possible, but requires syscall/configuration or an external deterministic join.
status_legend.weak: Not reliable as a primary causal source; useful only as a supplement/oracle.
status_legend.absent: Not available from the observed installation.
status_legend.conditional: Technically plausible, but no installed collector evidence exists here.

process_exec_create_exit.basis: Linux audit syscall records can cover execve, fork/clone, and exit with configured rules.

parent_child_ids.basis: Audit records expose pid/ppid and serial/event identifiers.

file_open_read_write_create_delete.basis: openat/read/write/creat/unlink/rename syscall rules are required; broad rules increase volume.

socket_bind_connect_accept_send_receive.basis: bind/connect/accept/accept4/send*/recv* syscall rules are required; semantic socket reconstruction is a normalization step.

timestamp_and_order.basis: Kernel audit timestamps plus serial IDs provide deterministic ordering within configured audit stream.

pid_netns_mapping.basis: PID is native; netns inode requires a synchronized /proc/<pid>/ns/net join while the process is alive.

event_loss_drop_reporting.basis: Audit status exposes backlog/lost counters that can be retained with the run.

raw_event_preservation.basis: Raw audit records can be retained before parsing in audit log files or a dispatcher stream.

privileges_and_overhead.basis: Root/audit-control privilege is required; syscall coverage must be bounded to control overhead.

mininet_compatibility.basis: Host-wide audit sees Mininet processes; namespace join disambiguates h1/h2 as demonstrated by E1A-R2.

logical_host_id_correlation.basis: Requires run manifest mapping netns inode and interface identity to h1/h2.

deterministic_parsing.basis: auditd/ausearch/libauparse formats are stable enough for a version-pinned parser with raw retention.

process_file_socket_causal_graph_suitabi.basis: One normalized syscall event stream can feed process/file/socket nodes and temporal edges after explicit joins.

auditd.selection_reason: Smallest standard Ubuntu collector with a kernel-backed event stream spanning process lifecycle, file syscalls, and socket syscalls; only one package and bounded audit rules are needed before smoke validation.

why_smallest_defensible: Ubuntu Jammy provides a version-pinned auditd package in the local index.
The running kernel enables AUDIT and AUDITSYSCALL.
Auditd spans the required process, file, and socket syscall families without writing a new kernel collector.
E1A-R2 already proves the deterministic PID/netns/logical_host_id join needed to disambiguate Mininet hosts.
Raw records and audit loss counters can be retained before graph conversion.
selection.required_next_validation: After human installation approval, run a bounded benign auditd smoke design with explicit rules and compare audit records against the E1A-R2 child/socket/pcap contract.
